title: Beyond Prediction: Steering VLM Agents with Retrospective World Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2609.39101v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Equipping VLM agents with world modeling capabilities has shown strong potential for complex reasoning and long-horizon planning, while reducing the dependence of policy learning on costly real-world interactions. Existing methods mainly rely on prospective simulation to predict the consequences of candidate actions. However, this forward-only paradigm focuses on what will happen next and provides limited constraints for verifying whether an action is causally consistent with the observed state transition, which can lead to plausible-looking but physically incoherent behaviors. In this paper, we challenge the view of world modeling as only prospective prediction and introduce Retrospective World Modeling, a new agent learning paradigm that enables agents to reason backward by estimating the retrospective attribution distribution $P(\hat{a}{t}|s_t, s{t+1})$ for the action that most likely caused a given transition. translated_title: 超越预测：基于回溯世界建模引导视觉语言模型智能体
translated_abstract: 为视觉语言模型（VLM）智能体配备世界建模能力，在复杂推理和长时程规划方面展现出强大潜力，同时降低了策略学习对昂贵的真实世界交互的依赖。现有方法主要依赖前瞻性模拟来预测候选动作的后果。然而，这种仅向前（forward-only）的范式聚焦于“接下来会发生什么”，对于验证动作是否与观测到的状态转移在因果上保持一致所提供的约束有限，这可能导致看似合理但物理上不连贯的行为。在本文中，我们挑战了将世界建模仅视为前瞻性预测的观点，提出了回溯世界建模——这是一种新的智能体学习范式，使智能体能够进行反向推理，通过估计回溯归因分布 $P(\hat{a}_t|s_t, s_{t+1})$ 来找出最有可能导致给定状态转移的动作。
tldr: 本文提出“回溯世界建模”新范式，使VLM智能体通过估计最可能引发给定状态转移的动作进行反向归因推理，突破了仅依赖前瞻预测的局限，从而避免看似合理但物理上不连贯的行为。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Retrospective World Modeling, a new paradigm that enables VLM agents to reason backward by estimating the retrospective attribution distribution of the action most likely to have caused a given state transition, moving beyond forward-only prediction to avoid plausible-looking but physically incoherent behaviors.
